# Clock

`cinnabar:extension/clock@0.1.0`

Local wall-clock time; requires the clock grant.

**Grants:** `clock`.

## Types

<a id="type-local-time"></a>

### `local-time`

Milliseconds since the Unix epoch and the local zone's current offset from UTC.

```wit
record local-time {
    unix-ms: u64,
    utc-offset-seconds: s32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unix-ms` | `u64` |  |
| `utc-offset-seconds` | `s32` |  |

## Functions

<a id="read-local-time"></a>

### `read-local-time`

```wit
read-local-time: func() -> result<local-time, string>;
```

Reads the local machine clock and its current UTC offset with clock authority.

Types: [`local-time`](clock.md#type-local-time).
